services.serviceDetailCtaSubtitle: Ask us about MCA, GST, income tax, trademark filings, bookkeeping, or any related business compliance—we respond with clear steps and timelines.
services.serviceDetailConsultationClosing:
We start from how your business runs day to day—that tells us which MCA, GST, tax, trademark, or allied obligations actually apply.

On consultation we listen first: what deadlines worry you and what paperwork you already have. Then we map a sensible sequence—what we prepare, what you submit on government portals—and we explain steps in ordinary language before you authorise filings.

MCA, GST, and income-tax cycles often overlap; we keep work coordinated instead of reinventing data in isolation. Reach us on WhatsApp or call for a clear next step, not jargon.

serviceList.title: MCA compliance (Companies & LLPs)
serviceList.description: ROC filings, annual returns, LLP and company MCA calendar, DIN/KYC support, statutory registers, board and AGM paperwork.
serviceList.subtitle: Stay current with the MCA for private limited companies and LLPs: forms, ROC deadlines, DIN/KYC, registers, resolutions, and AGM documentation—managed with reminders and clear status updates.
serviceList.mainHeading: Company & LLP MCA compliances handled end‑to‑end
serviceList.longDescription:
For incorporated businesses, MCA obligations run all year—from annual filings and event-based forms to director KYC and maintenance of statutory records. Missed ROC dates add avoidable penalties and stress.

Phinura Advisors helps you align your entity—company or LLP—to MCA requirements with a practical checklist: what is due, when it is due, and which documents portal teams expect.

We also support incorporation and post-incorporation steps (RUN, DIN/DSC coordination, filings after incorporation) so you are not juggling multiple vendors for the same Ministry.
serviceList.ctaTitle: Plan your MCA filings with us.
deliverables: Annual return and financial statement filings (including AOC-4 / relevant forms)
MGT-7 / MCA annual compliance as applicable
Director DIN and DIR-3 KYC support
Board meeting, AGM, and resolution documentation support
Statutory register maintenance guidance
Event-based ROC forms (director changes, capital, address, LLP partner updates)
Name reservations and incorporation support for new companies / LLPs
benefits: Structured calendar tuned to MCA due dates
Plain‑language summaries before you authorize filings
Single point of contact for ROC-related questions
Document readiness so filings are not last‑minute scrambles
Coordination aligned with GST and tax timelines where relevant
serviceList.consultationHeading: MCA consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
We start with your incorporation documents, financial year cadence, and any outstanding ROC filings—that tells us which annual returns, event-based forms, or director/KYC chores are overdue and how to prioritise them.

On consultation we listen first: AGM anxiety, unexplained ROC notices, capital or director changes stalled in draft, LLP partner updates waiting on DSC, or simply not knowing what the MCA expects next. We then spell out a practical calendar—documents to locate, drafts we circulate, MCA credentials your team uploads—always in straightforward language.

MCA timelines seldom sit alone; GST and income-tax seasons still matter. WhatsApp us or call and we propose the next ROC-safe step alongside your wider compliance picture—not template scripts.

serviceList.title: Trademark registration
serviceList.description: Search, filing, objections, and brand protection aligned with Indian trademark practice.
serviceList.subtitle: Trademark searches, class advice, filings with the Registry, replies to examination reports, and renewal planning—explained simply for SMEs.
serviceList.longDescription:
Your trading name and logo deserve protection before confusion or copying becomes expensive. Whether you operate as a firm, LLP, or company, the application process involves search, classification, timelines, and often correspondence with examiners.

We help you prioritise registrations that matter commercially, coordinate searches and filings, and keep renewal dates visible so marks do not lapse quietly.

Our focus stays practical: filings you can defend, timelines you can rely on, and communication you can understand.
deliverables: Trademark clearance / search summary
Class and specification guidance
Application drafting and Registry filing
Examination report and procedural follow‑up coordination
Renewal and maintenance reminders
Introduction to allied IP steps where needed
benefits: Earlier visibility on conflicting marks before you scale branding spend
Documentation handled with transparent milestones
Support rooted in SME budgets and timelines
serviceList.consultationHeading: Trademark consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
We open with where you operate, which logo or brand name worries you today, and any earlier Registry correspondence—that frames search scope, Nice class posture, and how examiner objections tend to land for your segment.

Consultation hears first whether you faced knock-off listings, hurried packaging runs, crowdfunding deadlines, expansion into new territories, or renewal dates slipping. Afterwards we prioritise filings, examiner replies, affidavits, or renewals—with plain English before drafting anything on Registry forms.

Trademark work still crosses GST invoicing and MCA shareholder updates when marks move entities. Ping us via WhatsApp or phone for a practical roadmap—not marketing hype.

serviceList.title: Accounting & bookkeeping
serviceList.description: Books aligned to filings: ledgers, reconciliations, MIS, and year-end readiness for statutory and tax disclosures.
serviceList.heroTitle: Books that stack up at year end
serviceList.subtitle: Systematic bookkeeping, bank and vendor reconciliations, inventory and expense discipline, closing support, and handoff notes for MCA, GST, and income-tax cycles.
serviceList.longDescription:
Reliable statutory work sits on dependable books—otherwise GST reconciliations, tax computations, and board-facing numbers fight the same inconsistencies.

We structure accounting around your operational reality: invoicing rhythms, payouts, petty cash discipline, payroll-related postings where applicable, and reconciliations that auditors and portals expect.

You get schedules and explanations that complement compliance filings rather than scrambling to rebuild numbers every quarter.
deliverables: Monthly / quarterly bookkeeping cycles
Bank, vendor, and key third-party reconciliations
GST-ready purchase and sale traceability basics
Year-end summaries and MIS packs for founders
Coordination drafts for auditors and statutory formats
benefits: Fewer shocks at filing deadlines
Clearer profitability and cash‑flow visibility between returns
Consistent narration for GST, MCA, and tax teams
serviceList.consultationHeading: Books & accounts consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
Our first look is invoicing rhythms, payouts, petty cash realities, payroll postings (if any), and how you reconcile bank—that tells us which ledgers will choke GST recon or audit questionnaires later.

We listen where reconciliations break, spreadsheets that never match portals, suspense entries nobody owns, POS exports drifting, or MIS packs boards still await. Next we choreograph close cycles—what your staff posts, what we tidy—and explain filings before auditors or portals lock numbers.

Solid books keep GST, MCA, and tax teams coordinated. Reach on WhatsApp or call—we point to the next housekeeping step with timelines you own.

serviceList.title: Income tax & taxation
serviceList.description: ITR preparation, deductions, advances, withholding basics, scrutiny coordination, and company or partner-level tax timelines.
serviceList.heroTitle: Income tax made routine, not frantic
serviceList.subtitle: For individuals, partners, proprietors, and firms or companies—we handle return preparation aligned to books, withholdings relevant to SMEs, reminders for advance-tax behaviour, and clear responses within scope.
serviceList.longDescription:
Income tax timelines run parallel to MCA and GST. When books, deductions, and withholding positions are unexplained until the last fortnight of July or September windows, filings become expensive errors.

We focus on disclosures that match GST and accounting reality, structuring compliance so annual returns and estimates are repeatable processes—not annual surprises.

Where deeper opinion or contested matters arise, we help you escalate with clarity.
deliverables: ITR drafting for applicable entity types within our scope
Form 26AS / AIS alignment checks explained simply
Advance tax planning reminders anchored to provisional numbers
TDS applicability guidance for SME transactions
Coordination drafts for departmental notices handled case‑by‑case
benefits: Filing drafts you can reconcile to books without guesswork
Calendar tied to MCA and GST workloads
Plain-language checkpoints before portals lock submissions
serviceList.consultationHeading: Income tax consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
We baseline your entity type—individual proprietor, LLP partner, or company—and whether books reconcile to Form 26AS / AIS so we map deductions, TDS withholdings, and advance-tax behaviour clearly.

Consultation absorbs refund anxiety, TDS riddles, belated ITR timelines, departmental letters, advance-tax guesses, or unease aligning partner remuneration with MCA resolutions. We then spell out filings, withholdings narratives, escalation paths—all in ordinary language prior to uploads.

Income tax never floats alone alongside GST balances and ROC events. WhatsApp us or call for the sober next tax-safe move.

serviceList.title: GST registrations & returns
serviceList.description: Registration amendments, outward/inward reconciliation discipline, quarterly or monthly filings, cancellations, and liaison planning common to SMEs.
serviceList.heroTitle: GST compliance your ops team can recognise
serviceList.subtitle: Registrations, amendments, regular returns with reconciliation narratives, LUT or refund conversations where modestly applicable, and table-readings that match your invoicing realities.
serviceList.mainHeading: GST aligned to how you invoice and purchase
serviceList.longDescription:
GST exposure is rarely one form—it is invoicing posture, reconciliation tables, mismatches, cancellations, refunds, LUT decisions, sector-specific quirks, plus annual reconciliations to books.

We keep filings tethered to your accounting rhythms and escalate mismatch themes early so cascading portal problems do not erupt at year-lock windows.

Where cross-border nuances matter, we triage applicability before you chase certificates you may not legally need.
deliverables: New GST registration and amendments (thematic cases)
GSTR‑1 / GSTR‑3B style cycles coordinated with bookkeeping
Reconciliation summaries between books and portals
Annual / closing reconciliations and documentation packs
Refund / LUT guidance where realistically in scope
benefits: Portal submissions described before you authorize them
Mismatch themes surfaced quarterly, not accidentally at closure
Coordination handshake with MCA and income tax calendars
serviceList.consultationHeading: GST consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
We typically begin with how you invoice, purchase, and close books each month—that tells us whether regular, composition, or export-linked GST patterns apply and which reconciliations will matter.

In consultation we listen first: mismatches between GSTR-2B / ITC claims and ledgers, refund or LUT doubts, amendment needs, or simply feeling behind on filings. Then we outline a practical sequence—what to fix first, which documents are useful to gather, what we draft versus what your team uploads—and we explain filings in ordinary language before you authorise anything on government portals.

GST stays aligned with MCA and income tax calendars where overlaps exist, so filings are not rebuilt in isolation. When you reach out—WhatsApp or call—we suggest a sensible next step and timelines you can rely on rather than jargon.

serviceList.title: Other business compliances
serviceList.description: Additional statutory hygiene—contracts with compliance touchpoints, industry registers, licences, certifications, PF/ESI coordination introductions, labour registers at a basic advisory level.
serviceList.subtitle: We help founders triage licences, registrations, filings, renewal calendars, PF/ESI introductions, Shops Act themes, IEC or MSME postures—as applicable—with realistic scope boundaries.
serviceList.mainHeading: Allied filings beyond MCA, GST, and core tax cycles
serviceList.longDescription:
Running a shop, factory desk, SaaS exporter, importer, LLP service firm, MSME claimant, labour-light office, consulting partnership—each drags incidental notifications, renewals, and registers.

We do not pretend one firm covers every speciality regulator; we help you classify what genuinely applies, avoid vanity registrations, anchor renewals beside GST and MCA timelines, and bring specialist partners visible when law or scale demands.

The aim is coherent compliance choreography rather than a shelf of orphaned certificates.
deliverables: Inventory of registrations and licences that plausibly apply
Renewal calendars cross-linked with major tax filings
Starter kits for Shops Act registers, IEC, MSME, etc., when relevant
Introduction and coordination scaffolding for payroll/PF‑ESI experts
Board-level compliance summaries founders can circulate
benefits: Less duplication across consultants
Cleaner board conversations about statutory posture
Honest escalation when specialist counsel beats generalist guesses
serviceList.consultationHeading: Compliance consultation — how we can help
serviceList.consultationClosing:
We triage licences, Shops Act registers, IEC renewals, MSME posture, PF/ESI introductions—only what realistically applies—without stacking vanity registrations.

Consultations align renewals beside GST / MCA calendars, prep introductions where specialist desks need to weigh in, and spell pragmatic board summaries you circulate internally—all in plain wording.

Ping us via WhatsApp or phone for sequencing—and candid referrals when narrower experts should lead.

story.title: A practice rooted in diligence—and built to scale with every client milestone.
story.lead: Phinura Advisors was established with one aim: give entrepreneurs and finance teams disciplined support for MCA, GST, income tax, and everyday accounting—explained plainly, executed reliably.
paragraphs: Our journey began as a deliberately lean team focusing on filings done right rather than churn. We listened to promoters who needed calm during GST cycles, ROC cadence, audits, notices, board paperwork, and the quiet administrative load that slows growth.

Relentless effort and clear communication widened both our clientele and breadth of mandates. Competitive clarity, brisk turnaround discipline, and strong digital tooling together keep remote coordination and paperwork movement predictable—even when timelines collide.

We think of ourselves as a comprehensive advisory partner rather than an ad-hoc desk: MCA and tax hygiene, bookkeeping alignment, introductions to payroll and statutory specialists where needed, and retainership conversations when founders want judgement on call.

With each passing year we have drafted new checklists from real client tensions—premium retainerships when leadership wants always-on stewardship, sharper reporting packs before investors, tighter coordination ahead of departmental queries—so reassurance travels with expansion.
trajectoryParagraphs: Starting with deliberate engagements alongside a curated client base, the firm matured into trusted counsel across retail, pharma, logistics, SaaS exporters, startups, partnerships, MSME corridors, founder-led firms, LLPs—and teams headquartered in Hyderabad supporting mandates that routinely span Indian metros.

Today's pipeline blends steady annual compliance with sharper special projects whenever statutes, investors, lenders, or board conversations demand choreography across GST, ROC, bookkeeping, staffing partners, diligence, trademarks, notices, retainership judgements—all sequenced deliberately rather than improvised.
